zh.title: 捷藍航空據報將兩架空中巴士A320改裝為VIP包機佈局
zh.summary: 捷藍航空據報將兩架A320改裝VIP佈局；為NHL提供包機服務
body: 據Simple Flying於2026年9月11日報導，捷藍航空據報將兩架空中巴士A320退出服務，重新配置為VIP包機佈局。
報導指出，該航空公司據報正準備這些飛機，為國家冰球聯盟（NHL）提供包機服務。
標題為「JetBlue Reportedly Takes 2 Airbus A320s Out Of Service To Be Reconfigured To VIP Charter Layout」，摘要稱「The airline is reportedly gearing these aircraft up to provide charter services for the NHL」。

en.title: JetBlue Reportedly Takes Two Airbus A320s Out of Service for VIP Charter Reconfiguration for NHL
en.summary: JetBlue reportedly reconfiguring two A320s for VIP charter layout to serve NHL
body: Simple Flying reported on 11 September 2026 that JetBlue is reportedly taking two Airbus A320 aircraft out of service to reconfigure them into a VIP charter layout for charter operations.
The article states that the airline is reportedly preparing these aircraft to provide charter services for the National Hockey League (NHL).

The headline reads "JetBlue Reportedly Takes 2 Airbus A320s Out Of Service To Be Reconfigured To VIP Charter Layout" and the summary notes "The airline is reportedly gearing these aircraft up to provide charter services for the NHL."
The information is attributed to Simple Flying.
